import boto3


AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID = 'YOUR_ACCESS_KEY_ID' 
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY = 'YOUR_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY'
DATABASE_NAME = 'YOUR_GLUE_CATALOG_DATABASE_NAME' 
TABLE_NAME = 'YOUR_GLUE_CATALOG_TABLE_NAME'
S3_BUCKET_NAME = 'YOUR_S3_BUCKET_NAME' 
S3_FOLDER_PATH = 's3://YOUR_S3_BUCKET_NAME/YOUR_S3_FOLDER_PATH/'

# Create a Glue client
glue_client = boto3.client('glue',
                           region_name='us-east-1',
                           aws_access_key_id=AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID,
                           aws_secret_access_key=AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY)



# Define the Glue Crawler's parameters
crawler_name = 'YOUR_CRAWLER_NAME'
crawler_params = {
    'Name': crawler_name,
    'Role': 'YOUR_GLUE_ROLE_ARN',
    'DatabaseName': DATABASE_NAME,
    'Targets': {
        'S3Targets': [
            {
                'Path': S3_FOLDER_PATH
            }
        ]
    }
}




# Set up the Glue client
glue_client = boto3.client('glue')



# Create a Glue Crawler that reads data from the specified S3 folder
response = glue_client.create_crawler(
    Name='my_crawler',
    Role='CRAWLER_ROLE_ARN',
    DatabaseName='my_database',
    TablePrefix='my_prefix',
    Targets={
        'S3Targets': [
            {
                'Path': 's3://my-bucket/my-folder/',
            }
        ]
    }
)


# Set up the Redshift and Glue clients
redshift_client = boto3.client('redshift')
glue_client = boto3.client('glue')



# Create the Redshift database
response = redshift_client.create_database(
    DBName='my_database',
    Encrypted=True
)



# Get the list of tables in the Glue Catalogue
response = glue_client.get_tables(
    DatabaseName='my_database',
    Expression='my_prefix*'
)



# Create an external table for each table in the Glue Catalogue
for table in response['TableList']:
    table_input = {
        'DatabaseName': 'my_database',
        'TableInput': table
    }
    response = glue_client.create_table(**table_input)
    redshift_client.create_table(**table_input)
